body:
[Erowid Note: 
The doses described in this report are potentially life threatening. The amount taken is beyond a heavy dose and could pose serious health risks or result in unwanted, extreme effects. Doses such as this have been known to cause hospitalizations and/or deaths. Sometimes extremely high doses reported are errors rather than actual doses used.]
*All acronyms/abbreviations are either generally accepted versions in my country, or capitalized (One Letter First Letter Per Word) abbreviations. Example: Hello Friends could potentially be typed in this report as HF, or hi Friends
*I have deliberately not corrected any typos (to accurately depict my state of mind. The more Typos you notice at any given trip time, the more likely I was inebriated at that time).
*Trip times are in the format Min:Seconds after first drug ingested.
Pre TR History
5 mg klonopin daily for 3 years
6mg Xanax daily for two months
So... High tolerance to benzos. Additionally I have a very high tolerance to alchohol due to liver enzymes and weight, and a moderate tolerance to opiates.
Start of Live TR
10 mg Xanax (5 2mg pills) @ 00:00
13:07 spaciness, slow breath, beginning of calm?
16:38 more spacey, headache hurts (I had one before Xanax dose)
25:09 weird saliva, headache really hurts in a weird way. Still functional online, and even moderating a live chat!
30:45 floaty and tingly
36:06 headache pains eyes slightly heavy
41:52 hungry but also not. Funyons nearby.
1:04 rip stomach. Hunger? Nausea?
1:12 little to no changes. Tolerance? Fuck lol
1:30 time flying by. Little to no change fun effects. Headache finally going down.
1:57 playing with mouth. No major changes.
2:08 podcast (when did I start listening to this?) nearly over. Flew by time wise. Memory seems fine.... motor skills??
2:29 omg motor skills rip. Just stood up. Typing was fine in live podcast stream though, thoughts are coherent as far as I know
2:31 + 10 mg additional Xanax. rip stumbling.
2:36 Im now walking downtown and apparently have left my apartment to trade a computer graphics card for 65$ cash and then immediately deposit in bank plz
2:37 Not high but VERY calm and relaxed
2:40 red crosswalk bothers me little but not as much as normal when Im in a rush
Feeling slightest bit drunk. Without body drunk ness. Head drunk. Floaty head. First time high from benzos ever?? Or maybe if I forget this tomorrow then I have been before and forgot also before? Rip :(
2:59 waiting for sell for graphics card. NO anxiety.  VERY CALM. Mostly relaxed physically. Very enjoyable. Such a high dose to achieve this is the only downside besides withdrawal? Idk should have researched more probably
3:00 :) feeling good typing is harder no worries feel safe to walk surprisingly. Id equate this to 4/5 beers due to my extremely high tolerance to benzodiazepines
Running equals headaches. Movements = kills high slightly if not more then slightly
3:21 depositing money from succesfull chill transaction (dont remember really what happened?) but Im safe and have the cash so...
Minor stumbles while texting
Feels similar to 10-15 mg Hydrocodone and thats being generous
3:26 Spending 20$ in a bar. Apparently I did not deposit the full 65$... Wish me luck.
Do I walk to bww or do I pay 💰 double for parking again? Fuck why did I pay its fee on sunday rip
Enjoyable high but dont expect weed high or opiate high. Its more of a calming relaxed chill experience to be more accurate.
Im pretty sure my memory is horrible but it doesnt actually feel bad at each given second
Fuck it gonna walk
Walking and exploring downtown is enjoyable. Not mind blowing but fun.
3:30 few stumbles here and there. Expecting the full 20mg (oral xanax pills) to kick in right when I get to bar. I will be careful considering theyre both CNS depressants dont worry please. Ive done this before and understand the risks.
Longer walks that I thought but calm enough not to really care too much besides my back tension. Headache is 95% gone. Finally (chronic migraines not headaches lol)
4 city blocks to go. No problem.
Lucky enough to hit every crosswalk with white hand/ guy
Scratch that six blocks to go. I parked to far but didnt want to waste 50 cents lmfao
Set an alarm for when to leave but I will have to fastwalk back to car or find another kiosk and pay more total meter ed parking then if I chose a parking structure. Yes i know Im complaining about dollars and cents
here which suddenly seem important.
Wait isnt it free on Sunday? I thought I already knew that? Wtf
4:01 4x 15% alc content pucker shots (3 oz.) down
Slight boost to previous effects.
Last drink will be Long Island - btw I ate street tacos happy hour for 4$ to fill my stomach up some for absorption. No idea how strong bww long islands are tbh
Post back in 15 or so minutes probably.
Sike 4:05 Long Island tastes sweet but low on alc content surprisingly
Fully expecting 5:00 after initial dose to elevate me to the next stage. Well see for science.
4:24 definitely buzzed also had a fuzzly navel whochbis low alc content mixed drink with 50% orange juice and 50% peach snaps but tasted amazing.
Considering a few more 2$ pucker shots.  Risky move thought
4:25 about to order pucker shots and potentially only tip 15% because money rn :(
4:26 one more 15% alc pucker shot for 2$ happy hou
Dw Im done drinking. Kept tab below 30$ even though I only had 20 cash somehow. Tipped and paid rest on debit card. Lets see how Xanax really acts with alcohol at high tolerance for both alchohol and benzodiazepines for me ;).
4:29 feeling great cant wait to walk back to car. Friend is driving me home for safety reasons.
Calm, body drunk, brain calm, relaxed and lazy.
Possibly going to add 1-2 mg klonopin later tonight. Yes I understand the risks but this is my life to risk.
I have not yet taken opiates or any other CNS Depressents besides benzos and alchohol at this point in my life.
I have codeine but I doubt Ill be stupid enough to add it to my current drug cocktail  - i know the risks - especially the APAP risks and cant do CWE at all unfortunately.
4:39 little to no change :(
4:52 feels like 6/7 beer total maybe?
Definitely gonna be stupid and dose small amount of codeine with small amount of Tylenol 30mg/300 mg
4:59 not faded like cannabis can do but buzzed and relaxed. Pretty nice.
Xanax has obviously taken affect and so has alchohol. Underwhelming compared it opiates/opiods atm.
Buzzed not drunk. Stumbling slightly but not even near blackout level on Xanax (high tolerance to both)
Definite stumbles while walking. Hard to urinate easily
5:10  Minorly faded at this point
Playing video games for how long now?
7:28 slickly faded. Didnt take any codein yet.
7:44 befime. Skepepy
7:50 goodnight
7:55 +2 mg Xanax
+50 mg Seroquel
+.5 mg klonopin.
7:57 Off to sleep. For real
POST TR notes. Definitely took that codeine and forgot completely. Woke up groggy but cant even remember if I felt shitty or good....
Conclusion: An enjoyable experience. However I personally would not pay moderate or higher prices for this experience. Its important to note that I was extremely impaired between 5:10 and 7:28 despite by claim of being slightly faded. I know this because of the people around me, and their reports. And the fact that I was actively and live typing a trip report for hours and simply forgot to add any comments for over 2 hours.
Be safe and know the risks. Research can save your life.
